description: The system shall allow an authenticated Hostel Resident to log a plumbing, electrical, or carpentry ticket using an assigned-room tag, issue severity, description, geo-location tag, and optional photo attachment.
acceptance: Pass: A complete ticket receives a unique ID, Reported status, timestamp, and Warden queue entry. Fail: A ticket is accepted without a room tag, category, or severity.
rationale: Captures actionable, location-specific information for maintenance triage.

description: The system shall validate that the room tag belongs to the authenticated resident before creating a ticket.
acceptance: Pass: A resident submits only for their assigned room; the room and geo-location are stored. Fail: A resident submits for another resident’s room.
rationale: Prevents false reports and gives staff the exact service location.

description: The system shall allow a resident to view the status and chronological history of their own tickets, including Reported, Assigned, In Progress, Resolved, and Closed.
acceptance: Pass: The resident sees every saved status change with its timestamp. Fail: The history omits an update or exposes another resident’s ticket.
rationale: Keeps residents informed and reduces repeated enquiries.

description: The system shall allow the Maintenance Warden to view, filter, prioritize, assign maintenance staff to, and update open tickets.
acceptance: Pass: The Warden filters the queue, assigns staff, and saves an update visible in ticket history. Fail: The assignment or update is not retained.
rationale: Supports accountable dispatch and operational tracking.

description: The system shall request resident closure sign-off when the Warden marks a ticket Resolved and shall close it only after confirmation or a documented Warden override.
acceptance: Pass: Resident confirmation records a sign-off timestamp and changes the ticket to Closed. Fail: A ticket closes without sign-off or override reason.
rationale: Confirms repair quality and records an auditable closure decision.

description: The system shall detect every high-priority ticket with no status change for 24 hours and queue an escalation SMS/email to the Maintenance Warden within 5 minutes of the SLA breach.
acceptance: Pass: With 100 overdue high-priority tickets under simulated peak load, every escalation is queued within 5 minutes and logged once. Fail: Any overdue ticket remains unalerted or receives a duplicate alert.
rationale: Ensures urgent issues cannot remain unattended.

description: The system shall require authentication, enforce role-based access control, and restrict residents to viewing and changing only their own tickets and attachments.
acceptance: Pass: A resident cannot access or alter another resident’s ticket by manipulating an ID or URL; Warden actions are audit logged. Fail: Cross-resident access or an unlogged Warden action succeeds.
rationale: Protects resident data and creates accountability.
